messages.充電を手段にして破裂威力と破裂回数を大量に付与する、破裂編成向けの人格。S1→S: An Identity for Rupture teams who uses Charge to inflict substantial Rupture Potency and Count. S1 followed by S2 can bring Charge Count to 10, enabling the enhanced S2 that supplies much of his Rupture.
messages.S2「エネルギー循環」: 使用時に充電回数が2/6/7増加。充電回数10以上なら: **S2 — Energy Cycle**: Gains 2/6/7 Charge Count on use. At 10 or more Charge Count, gains +1 Coin Power, and Coin Ⅱ adds 3 Rupture and 2 Rupture Count on top of its normal 3 Rupture. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S1「次元を裂く」: 使用時とⅠコイン的中時に充電回数が2ずつ増加し、破裂2を付: **S1 — Dimensional Slit**: Gains 2 Charge Count on use and another 2 when Coin Ⅰ hits; that Coin also inflicts 2 Rupture. At 10 or more Charge Count, gains +2 Coin Power.
messages.S3「次元の狭間」: 充電回数15未満なら10消耗してコイン威力+1、15あれば: **S3 — Dimensional Rift**: With 10–14 Charge Count, spends 10 for +1 Coin Power. With 15, spends 15 for +2 Coin Power and increases the target's Rupture Count by 3 before attacking. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 2/3 Rupture for every 5 Charge Count spent, up to 6/9. Spending 15 also lets it inflict 2 Dimensional Rift.
messages.バトルパッシブ「空にした頭」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン終了時、: **Combat passive — Emptied Thought (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, gains 1 Haste next turn for every 5 Charge Count, up to 2/3. When he consumes Charge Count through a skill, grants 3 Charge Barrier to the ally with the lowest current HP percentage.
messages.サポートパッシブ「整理師範教育」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 充電回数が: **Support passive — Cleanup Demonstration (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the most Charge Count deals +1.5% damage per Rupture Potency on the target, up to +15%.
messages.破裂編成に入れ、破裂威力と破裂回数の供給役として使う。同じターンにS1が先に動い: Use him to supply Rupture Potency and Count in a Rupture team. The extra Rupture Count on S2 and S3 requires Uptie Ⅳ. If S1 acts first in the same turn and Coin Ⅰ hits, he gains 4 Charge Count from its on-use and on-hit effects. S2's on-use gain then reaches 10 at the tiers that grant 6/7, enabling its additional Rupture and Count. If S1 was used on the previous turn instead, Turn End removes 1 Count: the +6 tier of S2 reaches only 9, while the +7 tier reaches 10. At 15 Charge Count, spend it on S3 to deliver 3 Rupture Count, substantial Rupture Potency, and Dimensional Rift together. He fits Rupture teams better than Charge teams and also works well with his Dimension Shredder E.G.O.
